After leaving the page realm the pacing gate no longer applies.
findings.gap: assertBodyProgressionIntegrity -> meridian integrityIssues replays strict-prefix, the page unlock (M-E D2) and the body_refinement prerequisite (C2C-64), but NOT the in-page realmLevel pacing. A save claiming more opened meridians than realmLevel permits is an unproducible state the boundary accepts.
findings.repro: qi_refining realmLevel 1 + body_refinement 6/6 + physiqueGrade 'bao' + openedIds = all 8 meridians -> validateGameSaveShape ok:true, assertBodyProgressionIntegrity does NOT throw (failing secure-expectation test); sibling probe 5 openedIds at realmLevel 8 also admitted (5th requires level 10)
findings.mint_path: applyAllBodyModifiers at restore emits bat-mach:<id>:<stat> percent modifiers for every id in openedIds -> forged +18% maxHp / +5% def / +8% hpRegenPerTurn / +5% might / +4% crit / +5% on all five main stats in visible beta play on every stat recompute

findings.notes: Same end state reachable via a fully consistent forged profile (realm claim + witnesses), which is an accepted residual class; this gap additionally admits an incoherent/unproducible claim the integrity contract was built to reject (M-E D2 precedent).

findings.repro: mortal realmLevel 1 + completedTiers=6 + currentTierProgress=0 + physiqueGrade 'bao' -> assertBodyProgressionIntegrity does NOT throw (failing secure-expectation test); collectBodyBaseStatDeltas returns non-empty deltas (documentary test passed)

findings.sibling_surface: any completedTiers k where the k-th tier's requiredRealmLevel exceeds mortal realmLevel; progress parked on a realmLevel-locked tier (currentTierProgress > 0 on a tier invest would refuse); breakthroughGrade bound <= bodyTiers+1 inherits the forged tier count
findings.notes: Mints harder than the meridian sibling because the base-stat channel needs no persisted modifier claim - the chapter state itself is the mint.
